payload.summary: Fast-forwarded main by five commits to 1c4c58f50. Retained recoverable stash a7c860dcf62b002cdfcc46581b67bbc0e44e6ce7. Resolved both Director/peer adapter overlaps and retained previous working edits/deletions. Earshot pins verified after restoring LF. Updated Classic dev running at loopback 3000, health200, Legitate-only true, unauthenticated Director401. Fresh WASM passes all20 Director tests. Reproduced a Windows atomic status replacement race in Node and Bun, then fixed it via per-file pending writes plus bounded rename retry; Node concurrent probe100 passed. The active first production build is warming native binaries; its source fingerprint predates the Director Windows fix.
